summary: Frontend-only i18n testing for TipJar. Verified 7-language selector (en/de/el/fr/it/ar/tr), full UI text switching for French/Italian/Turkish/Arabic, Arabic RTL flipping (document.documentElement.dir='rtl', lang='ar'), reversion to LTR when switching back to English, localStorage persistence (tj_lang), and absence of raw translation keys in the DOM. All acceptance criteria PASSED.

test_evidence.languages_in_dropdown: en:🇬🇧 English, de:🇩🇪 Deutsch, el:🇬🇷 Ελληνικά, fr:🇫🇷 Français, it:🇮🇹 Italiano, ar:🇸🇦 العربية, tr:🇹🇷 Türkçe (all 7 visible)
test_evidence.fr: nav-ratewall='Mur de notes', nav-invite='Inviter', nav-leaderboard='Classement', view-tips-btn='Voir les pronostics du jour', localStorage tj_lang='fr', doc.lang='fr', doc.dir='ltr'
test_evidence.tr: nav-ratewall='Puan Duvarı', nav-invite='Davet et', nav-leaderboard='Sıralama', view-tips-btn='Bugünün tahminlerini gör', tj_lang='tr', doc.dir='ltr'
test_evidence.ar: nav-ratewall='جدار التقييم', nav-invite='دعوة', nav-leaderboard='المتصدرون', view-tips-btn='عرض توقعات اليوم', tj_lang='ar', doc.lang='ar', doc.dir='rtl' (RTL layout confirmed visually in screenshot)
test_evidence.it: nav-ratewall='Muro dei voti', nav-invite='Invita', tj_lang='it', doc.dir='ltr'
test_evidence.en_after_ar: nav-ratewall='Rate Wall', doc.dir='ltr' (correctly reverted), doc.lang='en', tj_lang='en'
test_evidence.raw_keys_scan: No raw i18n keys (nav.ratewall, nav.invite, hero.title, wall.title, submit.title, invite.title, wallet.title, auth.login) found in body text for any tested language

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/i18n.js is 1267 lines (>700 line guideline). Consider splitting per-language dictionaries into separate files (e.g. src/i18n/en.js, src/i18n/fr.js) with a small provider that imports them. Purely a maintainability improvement — not a functional bug.
I18nProvider applies dir on mount via useEffect AND again inside setLang; slight duplication but harmless (idempotent).
Fallback chain in t() falls back to English if a key is missing in the target locale — good, guarantees no raw keys leak to UI (verified).
test_credentials: not applicable — no login required for i18n tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: i18n additions (fr/it/ar/tr) fully verified end-to-end via the Header language switcher on the deployed preview. Selectors used: [data-testid='language-switcher'], [data-testid='lang-{code}'], [data-testid='nav-ratewall'|'nav-invite'|'nav-leaderboard'|'view-tips-btn']. RTL is applied only for 'ar' (RTL_LANGS=['ar'] in /app/frontend/src/i18n.js) and reverts to ltr on any other language.
rca of the issue: No issue — feature works as specified.
